summary_1line: Utanka secures Madayanti’s magical earrings with Saudasa’s sign but loses them when a snake steals them after the knot holding them loosens.

image_candidates.scene_text: Utanka hangs his black deerskin on a branch of a fruit-laden Vilwa tree while plucking fruits above it.
As fruits strike the hanging deerskin, the knot loosens and the jewelled earrings tumble to the ground beneath the tree.
A swift serpent of Airavata’s race snatches the glittering earrings in its mouth and slips into a hole in the earth.
